title: OpenClaw gets web search and a clearer setup path
summary:
OpenClaw gained web-search options and a simpler setup path, community-built n8n nodes joined the directory, and the alpha NomNom model was removed.

OpenClaw setup now offers `gemini-search` for web-grounded answers and Perplexity search through the Pollinations API, while preserving an existing search provider. Its onboarding page has one shared connection step, then separate instructions for a fresh install or an existing agent. The suggested model list and descriptions were also updated.

@isaacgounton’s community-built n8n package, with image, video, text, and audio nodes, was added to the developer-tools directory. The README also lists @tefa2007h-dev’s CHATTY AI web app.

The alpha NomNom web-research model was removed from the text model registry and routing, along with its `gemini-scrape` and `web-research` aliases.
